author: Linnaeus, 1758

months.note: 2005년 9월 30일 서산에서 발견된 어린새가 10월 초순까지 머물렀으며, 국내에서 기록된 달이다.

summary: 2005년 9월 말 충남 서산 간척지에서 어린새 한 마리가 처음 기록된 길잃은새로, 국내 기록은 지금까지 10건이 채 되지 않는다. 유라시아 북부의 툰드라와 높은 산의 평평한 능선에서 번식하고, 북아프리카에서 중동에 이르는 반사막과 농경지에서 겨울을 난다. 이동할 때는 해마다 같은 곳의 탁 트인 밭이나 짧은 풀밭에 작은 무리로 들르며, 사람을 별로 경계하지 않는다. 번식지에서는 암컷보다 수수한 수컷이 주로 알을 품고 새끼를 돌본다.

points.en: broad white supercilia meeting on the nape, contrasting with the dark crown
narrow white band across the breast

sexes.male: 암컷보다 색이 수수하고, 여름깃에서 배의 검은 부분이 작은 편이다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 색과 무늬가 더 짙고 선명하다.

young: 어린새는 어른새 겨울깃처럼 수수하나 등과 어깨깃이 흑갈색 바탕에 황갈색 깃 가장자리가 있어 비늘 무늬처럼 보이고, 가슴에 거무스름한 줄무늬가 있다. 흰 눈썹선은 어른새처럼 뒷머리에서 만난다.

art.subject: Eurasian Dotterel (Eudromias morinellus), adult female in breeding plumage, as on spring passage in May: crown blackish-brown; broad white supercilia running from above the eye to meet in a V on the nape; face and throat white; neck and upper breast blue-grey; a narrow white band across the breast, edged above by a thin black line; lower breast and flanks rich chestnut-orange; centre of the belly black; vent and undertail coverts white; upperparts grey-brown with buff-rufous fringes to the scapulars and tertials. Bill short, slender and black; dark eye; legs dull yellow.
art.pose: standing upright on short turf, side view, head slightly raised
art.scene: Dry short-grass field near the Korean coast in May during spring migration, soft morning light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult female in breeding plumage, side view standing upright on short turf: blackish crown, broad white supercilia meeting on the nape, white throat, narrow white breast band, orange-chestnut lower breast and flanks, blackish belly, white vent, grey-brown upperparts, short black bill, yellow legs

juvenile in autumn, side view standing: paler overall, pale supercilia meeting on the nape, indistinct pale breast band, pale buff underparts without chestnut or black, grey-brown upperparts with pale feather fringes giving a scaly look, short black bill, yellow legs
art.build: Plump, round-headed plover, smaller than Pacific Golden Plover and much smaller than a pigeon, with a short neck and a level, rather tame stance. Bill black, short and fine, much shorter than the head. Legs dull yellow to greenish-yellow, medium length. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. In flight the upperwing is plain grey-brown with no wing-bar, only a white shaft to the outermost primary. Females are brighter than males; males are duller, with a streakier crown and less chestnut and black below.
avoid: Do not paint a white wing-bar; the Dotterel's upperwing is plain.
Do not stop the white supercilium at the eye; it is long and broad and meets its partner in a V on the nape.
Do not paint a black face and throat (Grey or Pacific Golden Plover in breeding plumage); the Dotterel's face and throat are white.
Do not paint black or pink legs, or a long bill.
